thread:
alyssa: SOC asks for a 90d SIEM export for a customer incident. vendor wants KMS unwrap — can we do this without handing over our private keys?
matt: yes, but only via export-service JIT unwrap or vendor-side HSM. no permanent KMS unwrap grants.
sara: two paths: (1) JIT unwrap token (preferred) — audit logged + TTL; (2) emergency scoped key grant — requires sec leadership signoff and ticketed justification.
kevin: push vendor retention to 30d. if they insist on >30d, need signed DPA + proof of controls and a privacy review. log vendor acceptance in ticket.
alyssa: filing INC-2026-888 now with scope and initial justification, will ask for JIT. @matt can you verify the RBAC checklist?
oncall-bot: Incident INC-2026-888 snapshot created by alyssa at 2026-04-03T11:07:14Z :lock:
matt: RBAC checklist notes: approvers (sara/kevin), export_hash required, auditor field, and ticket must list exact indexes/sources. link: https://internal.redwood.com/infra/rbac-matrix (read-only)
kevin: ops requirement: set KMS flag Rotate-On-Unwrap=true for all external unwraps. vendor must receive only a wrapped blob + unwrap token — never private key material.
sara: runbook action: I'll add a 5-step snippet to eng-sec docs: open ticket, narrow scope, request JIT export, verify DPA if >30d, rotate keys post-unwrap.
alyssa: SOC wants the exact command. paste an export-service example here so they can run it.
matt: example:
```
export-service create --incident INC-2026-888 \n  --scope "svc:auth,app:login-logs" \n  --retention 30d \n  --unwrap jitted --ttl 1h \n  --approver "matt" --note "forensic handoff"
```
This returns: unwrap_token, export_id, audit_id. Add audit_id to the ticket.
kevin: also require: requester, vendor_name, data_scope, retention_until, export_hash, evidence_path in the ticket before grant.
alyssa: noted. I'll update the ticket with narrowed scope and DPA ask. please ack in the ticket when you sign off.
matt: ack, will review RBAC + sign off EOD.
kevin: reminder: any export >30d auto-creates PRIV-REQ for privacy team review (do not bypass).
sara: fyi — if vendor wants their own KMS wrap, we can wrap to their public key (no unwrap privilege on our side) and provide metadata; that's preferred for longer retention.
alyssa: thanks everyone. I'll attach vendor contact and return with the export id when created. :thumbsup:
